name: Question 2
problem:
Find the equation of the osculating plane (in parametric form) for a curve $r(t)$ at the point $P(-1,0,1)$ where $t=\pi $, given that

$$
\begin{aligned}T(\pi )=\frac{3}{5}\,i-\frac{4}{5}k,\,N(\pi )=-j.\end{aligned}
$$

Note that $T$ and $N$ denote the unit tangent and principal normal, respectively.

Question 2

Find the equation of the osculating plane (in parametric form) for a curve r(t) at the point P(−1,0,1) where t=π, given that

T(π)=35i−45k,N(π)=−j.

Note that T and N denote the unit tangent and principal normal, respectively.

a
 R(s,u)=(5+3s)i−5(u−1)j+(5−4s)k
b
 R(s,u)=(35−s)i−uj+(45+s)k
c
 R(s,u)=(1+35s)i−(1+u)j+(1−45s)k
d
 R(s,u)=(−1+35s)i−uj+(1−45s)k
e
 R(s,u)=(−1+3s)i−j+(1−4s)k
